statement: Lambda lists on-demand NVIDIA H100 SXM at $3.99-$4.29 per GPU-hour and B200 SXM6 at $6.69-$6.99 per GPU-hour, with reserved cluster pricing from $5.54 (H100) and $8.87 (B200) at scale.
why: Published rental rates are a live read on what GPU capacity clears at, useful as a display overlay against vendor hardware pricing.

impact.mechanism: Rental price levels set the cost basis for renting rather than buying accelerators, but this snapshot carries no baseline or change so it scores nothing.

evidence.source: Lambda (lambda.ai) official GPU cloud pricing page
Lambda (lambda.ai) official GPU cloud pricing page
evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA HGX B200 -- 16 GPUs: "$9.86" per GPU/hour; 64 GPUs: "$9.36" per GPU/hour; 256+ GPUs: "$8.87" per GPU/hour

confidence.basis: Vendor's own live price page, but a single publisher and a static snapshot with no prior baseline.

dispersion: On-demand rates span a range per model (e.g. H100 $3.99-$4.29); reserved rates fall with cluster size.
